bear.point: FY26 revenue growth of 11.8% missed the 15% guidance, indicating execution slippage.
Group EBITDA margin fell to 9.0% from 9.9% YoY, compressing profitability.
Trailing 12-month ROE declined to 16.1% from 17%, reducing shareholder returns.
Analysts fear prospect list shifts to next year, threatening order inflow continuity.

bull.point: Q1 FY27 order inflows hit Rs. 1,080 billion, up 14% YoY.
Total order book reached Rs. 7.79 trillion, up 27% from June 2025.
NWC to Sales ratio improved to 4.9%, beating the 10% target.
Group PAT grew 14% YoY to Rs. 41 billion in Q1 FY27.
